description:
• About our brand and products: Kuvola is a premium travel wellness brand from Sweden. Our flagship product is a humidifier mask for airline travelers that addresses one of the most overlooked problems in modern aviation: cabin air at cruising altitude drops to 4–12% humidity — drier than the Sahara Desert. Using Heat and Moisture Exchange technology, the mask captures moisture as you exhale and returns it to the fresh air you breathe in. No water, no batteries, no electronics. Manufactured to medical-grade standards in the UK and designed in Stockholm. Priced at $85, with replacement filter packs available separately.


• What makes us different: Most travel wellness products address symptoms after they appear. Kuvola addresses the cause — directly and passively, throughout the entire flight. The technology is the same class used in medical respiratory care, redesigned as a purposeful travel essential.


• How affiliates can earn: Affiliates earn 20% commission on every sale generated through their unique link. Average order value is $85, with additional revenue from filter pack repurchases. Cookies are tracked for 30 days. Payouts are processed monthly after the returns window has closed with no minimum threshold.


• How to promote us: the most effective content is authentic and experience-based — filmed during a real flight or airport moment. First-person accounts of using Kuvola consistently outperform scripted promotional content. Written reviews, newsletter features, YouTube integrations, and social posts all perform well. We provide product, brand assets, and key messaging on request.

• Other information: We offer complimentary product to all affiliate partners before any content goes live. We are a small, founder-led brand and respond quickly. If you have a specific content idea or partnership structure in mind, reach out directly — we are open to custom arrangements for the right fit.
payout_period: Payouts are paid at the end of the month, the following month, after the return window has close. For example if an order is made on February 10, the return window closes February 24, and the payout will be made at the end of March.
